1. I hear about mass shootings constantly on CNN and NPR, and it scares me - my kids deserve to be safe at school. The gun lobby seems way too powerful and we need common sense reforms like background checks. | A

2. The Second Amendment is under attack and criminals don't follow laws anyway - more restrictions just hurt law-abiding citizens like me who want to protect our families. Dan Bongino and Mark Levin are right that gun control is really about government control. | B

3. After all these school shootings and violence, something has to change - I can't understand why we make it so easy for dangerous people to get weapons. My news sources consistently show that most Americans want stricter background checks and waiting periods. | A

4. The Constitution is clear about the right to bear arms, and every new law they pass just chips away at our freedoms - criminals will always find guns but honest Americans get punished. My pastor and neighbors agree that more laws aren't the answer to stopping evil. | B

5. I know gun violence is a problem but most of the proposed laws wouldn't have stopped the recent attacks anyway, and I worry about making it harder for people like me to defend ourselves in dangerous neighborhoods. Maybe the current system just needs better enforcement. | C
